title: Mike Vrabel on Romeo Doubs: Everyone drops a pass, he's excited to get back out there

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Mike Vrabel on Romeo Doubs: Everyone drops a pass, he's excited to get back out there
sources.description: Romeo Doubs was one of the biggest additions to the Patriots roster during the offseason, but his first outing for his new team was not a successful one.
